saints.name: Sts. Marcellinus and Peter
saints.title: Martyrs
saints.shortBlurb: A Roman priest and an exorcist who died together under Diocletian and are still named in the Canon of the Mass…
biography: Marcellinus, a priest, and Peter, an exorcist, were among the most celebrated martyrs of the Roman Church, put to death in the persecution of Diocletian about the year 304. According to the epitaph composed by Pope St. Damasus, who as a boy had heard the account from their executioner, they were beheaded in a hidden place and buried on the Via Labicana.

The Emperor Constantine built a basilica over their tomb, near which his mother, St. Helena, was laid to rest. Their names were placed in the Canon of the Mass, where they are still invoked among the martyrs.
saints.knownFor: Their witness under Diocletian; named in the Roman Canon.
